query: select n.nspname as schema_name, p.proname, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public', 'private') and p.proname in ('create_order_from_items', 'has_role', 'is_platform_admin', 'owns_shop', 'handle_new_user', 'set_updated_at') order by n.nspname, p.proname limit 50;
